profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Building Scalable AI-Driven Systems | 7+ Years Experience at Capital One & CVS Health
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer | MS in Computer Science (AI/ML) | Full Stack Expert

I am a Full Stack Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable web applications and intelligent systems for Fortune 100 companies. My background combines rigorous enterprise software engineering at Capital One and CVS Health with a specialized Master’s in Computer Science from Georgia Tech focused where I focused on Machine Learning.

How I drive value:

Scalable AI Integration: I don't just build models; I integrate them into production environments. I have built everything from Transformer-based GPT clones to Reinforcement Learning stock traders.

Performance Engineering: I specialize in transforming slow, manual processes into high-speed digital solutions, such as reducing signup times by 80% at Capital One and drug pricing times by 90% at CVS Health.

Full Stack Mastery: Expert in Java/Spring, Python, and Modern Frontend (Next.js, Angular, React) with a focus on REST micro services and AWS cloud architecture.

Core Tech Stack:

AI/ML: PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain, Transformers, OpenAI API.

Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Python, SQL, REST APIs.

Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Angular, Lit Element, Tailwind CSS.

Cloud: AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda, SNS), Jenkins, Docker.

I am passionate about building the next generation of AI-driven products. Let’s connect if you’re looking for an engineer who can bridge the gap between complex research and production-ready software.

I am currently exploring Senior/Mid-level roles in AI Engineering or Senior Full Stack positions where I can leverage my ML background. If you are looking for an engineer who can bridge the gap between complex data models and production-ready applications, let’s connect or reach out at patelharsh94@gmail.com.

positions.title: Sr.Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Spearheaded implementation of an auto-fill feature, significantly reducing signup times by 50%-80% and increasing conversion by 10%. (Java Spring, RDS, S3, RestAPIs, Angular)
* Built a portal using Lit element to allow agents to share inventory across dealers and run dealer feeds saving automating something that took countless developer hours every sprint. (HTML, CSS, Typescript, Java, Spring, RestAPIs, Lit Element)
* Created AB tests for diverse landing page designs, resulting in a more interactive and user-friendly experience. (Angular, HTML, CSS, S3, Analytics)
* Led the integration of Medallia, a 3rd party survey software, into the Autonavigator website, enhancing customer feedback mechanisms. (Angular, HTML, CSS, S3)
* Supported the integration of Sacks 5th Ave into Capital One’s Credit Card platform by utilizing lambdas, python and other AWS tools. (Python, Lambda, S3, ECS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Was the single point of contact for majority of the ETL at OH (Outcome Health).  
- Managed, improved, and maintained the ETL system end to end (From gathering requirements, to coding, to creating efficient tables in Redshift, to deploying code to ECS).
- Worked on company wide project to consolidate all of our asset information; wrote python code to clean, transform large amounts asset data collected in different forms since the company’s conception.  The project is a huge added value to the company's bottom line and also to the company’s supply chain management process. 
- Created a process to import, clean and store asset data effectively and efficiently at OH.
- Wrote ETL tasks from scratch using Python while leveraging AWS S3, Redshift, EC2 and Docker. 
- Improved the efficiency of the ETL system by a huge margin (what used to finish running by 8 am, now runs consistently by 5 am).  I also worked to reduce failure rates of the ETL. 
- Implemented PagerDuty support using AWS Lambda for the ETL, so I get paged when there are any errors/failures. 
- Effectively trained other engineers to work on the ETL and Data Warehouse.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Data Analysis · Docker · Problem Analysis · Communication · Pressure Situations · Test-Driven Development · Problem Solving · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Working on the 3D maps team, to help build more interactive, and beautiful maps.  
- Wrote clean and maintainable Java code on projects that enabled the team to run Hadoop jobs on a much larger scale, in an efficient and fast manner.  (The jobs that used to run on small cities can now run on large continents, and in some cases can handle the entire world) 
- Wrote Java code that improved the efficiency of the testing process by a huge margin, before one Hadoop job was ran per city, now one job can be ran for multiple cities and landmarks across the entire world.  This way data gets populated faster and with very little interference from humans.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Data Analysis · Problem Analysis · Communication · Test-Driven Development · Problem Solving · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Data Science Intern Spring 2016
positions.description:
- Used Python (Pandas) and the Asana API to analyze large amounts of data created by the Data Science team at Uptake. 
- Made dynamic reports about the productivity of the team and the individual members of the team.
- Debugged large amounts of previously written code.  
- Worked with bash and python to automate tasks, such as running all the scripts, pushing work to Github, uploading work to Google Drive, and emailing people about their work.

projects.title: Web Chat Application
projects.description:
This is a web-chat application I wrote as a final project for CS 341: Programming Languages.  We were given a challenge of learning a new language or frame work in one week and making a project with it.  We decided to learn how to make  web-apps; In this app I was responsible for design, animations and user authentication. 

We made a video explaining the code which can be found here: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RDucHkDbDnw
